title: Apply for pensioner council rates rebates
summary: Find out about and apply for concessions available to eligible pensioners on their council rates.
intro:
Concessions are available to eligible pensioners on their council rates, including:

If your water is not supplied by your local council, find out if you are eligible for the pensioner water rebate.
who_can_apply: Be a War Widow or War Widower and entitled to the DVA income support supplement (ISS) which attracts a PCC.
Be a Wholly Dependent Partner and entitled to the DVA ISS which attracts a PCC.
Note: Rebates may also be granted to people suffering financial hardship in certain circumstances.
what_you_need: Your council rates account number or customer number (on your rates bill).
A concession card or concession customer reference number.
Check your rates bill before completing the claim form, as you may already be receiving the pension rebate.

how_to_steps.text: Check that you meet the eligibility criteria.
Get the contact details for your local council.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for pensioner council rates rebates?
faqs.a: You may be eligible if you are a War Widow or War Widower entitled to the DVA income support supplement (ISS) which attracts a PCC, or a Wholly Dependent Partner entitled to the DVA ISS which attracts a PCC.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for the rebate?
faqs.a: You need your council rates account number or customer number (on your rates bill) and a concession card or concession customer reference number.

faqs.q: Are there other rebates I should know about?
faqs.a: If your water is not supplied by your local council, you can find out if you are eligible for the pensioner water rebate.
